lead.why: Abstract: 'Compounds 14, 24 and 25 manifested strong antiviral effects against CVB1 and PV1 (SI values of 405 and 118)'; 14 is named first, and the text says 14 showed the highest in vivo activity (PI 50%) and the closest resemblance to MDL-860.

reactions.conditions: GP1: phenol (1.2 eq) + powdered NaOH (1.2 eq) in dry DMSO, 50 C 20 min; then 2-chloro-5-nitrobenzonitrile (1.0 eq), 80 C, 8 h; water, DCM extraction, column; 84%.
reactions.source: main text p.2 (Scheme 1 discussion); SI S2, General procedure 1 and compound 14 entry

notes: Phenol 2 is not named in the text layer (scheme drawing not extracted); its identity as 3,4-difluorophenol is derived from the printed product name of 14 and the SI quantity (0.256 g = 1.97 mmol, MW 130). Paper states all starting compounds except phenols 7 and 8 are commercial.
